title: Fix three bugs in Rust string utility functions
description: Fix three bugs in string utility functions: reverse returns original, count_vowels counts consonants, title_case lowercases everything.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. `reverse`: use `.chars().rev().collect()` instead of returning the original
2. `count_vowels`: remove the `!` negation so `.filter(|c| "aeiouAEIOU".contains(*c))` counts vowels
3. `title_case`: capitalise the first char and lowercase the rest — `let mut c = word.chars(); c.next().map(|f| f.to_uppercase().to_string() + &c.as_str().to_lowercase()).unwrap_or_default()`
All 6 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
